name: WP Engine
tagline: Premium managed WordPress hosting with a proprietary dashboard and visit-based tiers
description: WP Engine is a managed WordPress-only hosting platform priced per plan tier with monthly visit and storage caps, built around its own proprietary User Portal rather than cPanel.
about: WP Engine's plans run Essential, Core and Enterprise. Essential is the self-service entry tier, listed from $28/month on annual billing, and covers 1-30 WordPress installs, 25,000-400,000 monthly visits and 10-50GB storage depending on how far up the tier you sit; WP Engine also runs a 20% first-year discount for new customers on Essential, so double-check the live plans page for the current rate before buying. Core and Enterprise move to isolated resources, higher visit/storage ceilings, and custom pricing quoted only after contacting sales.

Because Essential, Core and higher tiers are priced around a monthly visit allowance rather than unlimited traffic, exceeding that allowance triggers an overage charge of $2 per 1,000 extra monthly visitors rather than a hard suspension — worth budgeting for if traffic is seasonal or spikes unpredictably. There's also no cPanel here: site management runs through WP Engine's own web-based User Portal, which is a different workflow than a typical shared-hosting cPanel migration.
policies: WP Engine offers a 60-day money-back guarantee on annual billing plans; domain fees, add-ons and custom development work are excluded, and refund requests must be made within that 60-day window.
